title: leucanthemopsis pulverulenta subsp. pseudopulverulenta
intro: Leucanthemopsis pulverulenta subsp. pseudopulverulenta, commonly known as the 'Alpine Daisy', is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to high-altitude regions in Europe. The health benefits of the Alpine Daisy are associated with its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Leucanthemopsis pulverulenta subsp. pseudopulverulenta include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
